thesis: Intel guided PC market to decline into 2H27 (Client Computing missed by ~$0.7B); Corsair (PC components/peripherals) reports Q3 on Nov 5 and sector sympathy (HPQ -10% premarket) has not hit CRSR yet, which closed flat/up. Expect cautious guide or sympathy selling into earnings. Weakest link: DRAM-kit price inflation may lift Corsair revenue and offset PC unit weakness.
